༄༅/ /lam khyer rnam gsum gcig tu dril ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam khyer rnam gsum gcig tu dril ba bzhugs/

bla ma dang yi dam gyis dge bar mdzod cig /lam khyer rnam gsum gcig tu dril nas nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes chos drug gi sgyu lus ltar bya/ dngos gzhi rang yi dam bde mchog spyi bor bla ma yid dam dbyer med kyi bskur mos shing rnam pa bla ma gsal btab nas/ mos gus drag pos yang gsol 'debs bya/ yang na rnam pa bla mas dbu brgyan pa'i yi dam du sgom yang rung ngo*/ /de nas dngos dang dran yul du byung ba'i rang gzhan gyi sgra zin ma zin thams cad la bla ma yid dam dbyer med kyi gsung sngags su mos/ sems kyi 'char sgo ci byung yang bla ma yid dam dbyer med kyi thugs su mos shing*/ snang ba thams cad sems dang*/ sems skye 'gag gnas gsum gdod ma nas stong pa'i rang ngo la cher blta zhing thag chod bya/ de ka'i ngang la dug lnga dang tha mal rnam rtog ci byung rung*/ de rang gi ngo bo la ngo shes ngang bskyangs pas/ ma spangs rang dag ces bya/ thun mtshams kun la bzla/ snang ba sku/ grags pa gsung rten rtogs thugs su thag chod pa dang*/ mos gus lha sku/ snang ba rang sems/ sems sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa'am/ dran 'dun rtsa bral lam/ min na'ang ngo shes dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bya/ bla mas rang gnas lugs zab mo la dkri bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin dran pas bla ma yi dam ro gcig pa la mchod bstod yan lag bdun pa bya zhing tshogs bsogs/ 'di la myong ba ci rigs byung nas/ 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed kyi sgyu lus/ rmi lam bzungs sbyangs spel bsgyur ba rnams dang sbrel nas nyams su len pa 'di ni snying po'o/ / bla ma lam 'khyer la snang ba la brten nas bla ma lam du 'khyer ba dang*/ de bzhin du bla ma la mos gus/ de la bka' drin/ de la tshogs bsogs/ de la rang shar lam du 'khyer/ yi dam lam 'khyer la/ snang ba yid dam/ dag snang tshogs bsogs/ rang shar zung 'jug gi lha sku dang*/

sgyu ma lam 'khyer la/ snang ba rang sems sgyu ma rmi lam/ 'od gsal rang shar rnams lam du 'khyer ba ste de ltar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na snang ba bla ma yi dam du shes/ de rang sems su shes/ de sgyu ma lta bu gsal shing bde ba rang shar ro// //zhes pa 'di yang kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - PAGE 292 -- PAGE 291 -
